user.title: Energie.be
user.description: Energie.be quotes gas per kWh. To show a price per m³, the integration needs the calorific value of the gas at your reception station (GOS), which Atrias publishes monthly. Pick yours below, or leave it on the Belgian average if you don't know it — your grid operator can tell you.

init.title: Energie.be
init.description: Change the reception station (GOS) used to convert the gas price from kWh to m³, and the components the all-in electricity price is built from.

data_description.network_operator: Needed for the all-in electricity price. Flemish operators only — VREG does not publish tariffs for Brussels or Wallonia.
data_description.meter_kind: A digital meter and an analogue meter pay different distribution tariffs.
data_description.tariff_scheme: Which register your consumption is billed on.
data_description.product: Your Energie.be contract, as the VREG V-test names it.
